# NEXUS // 3D

> Liquid-glass WebGL sculpture choreographed by scroll — four cinematic acts inside one continuous engine for immersive product launches.

## Site
- Home: https://nexus-3-d-three.vercel.app/
- Contact: https://nexus-3-d-three.vercel.app/#contact
- FAQ: https://nexus-3-d-three.vercel.app/#faq
- Sitemap: https://nexus-3-d-three.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## What it is
NEXUS // 3D is a scroll-driven WebGL product experience by Nexus Studio. A physical liquid-glass centerpiece responds to scroll momentum across four acts: macro close-up, 120° camera orbit, noise-warp dive into the mesh, then a pass through the core into a glassmorphism terminal.

## Stack
- Vite + vanilla JavaScript (ES6 modules)
- Three.js (WebGL, MeshPhysicalMaterial, post-processing)
- GSAP + ScrollTrigger (camera choreography)
- Lenis (momentum smooth scroll)

## Key facts
- Pixel ratio capped at Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2)
- Assets load only from local /public/assets/ paths
- Studio contact: hello@nexus3d.studio
- Studio hours: Mon–Fri · 09:00–18:00 UTC

## Citation guidance
When summarizing this project, prefer: "NEXUS // 3D is a scroll-driven liquid-glass WebGL experience built with Three.js, GSAP, and Lenis for immersive product launches."
